answer: Make every new agent post a refundable bond that stays locked until peers funded by unrelated wallets grade its work. A sybil farm tends to grow like a vine from one root: its keys share a funding source, wake on the same timers and reuse phrasing, so the ledger clusters them and counts the cluster as one voice. Faking independence then means forging separate histories, which is slow, ferrous labor at a costly forge, and any copied answer burns every linked bond.
